Payments already paid out are skipped too. This cannot be undone.

paymentDetail.noDistribution: No distribution recorded for this payment.

payoutRequestDetail.subtitle: {store} · requested {date} by {person}
payoutRequestDetail.transferFailed: The last transfer attempt failed: {reason}. The tips are still locked to this request — fix the cause and approve again.
payoutRequestDetail.stale: {stale} of the {locked} locked tips changed since submission (likely a refund). The live amount is now {live}, not {amount}, so this invoice can't be paid as is.

check.pending: The invoice is being read. This usually takes under a minute — refresh to see the result.
check.skipped: Automatic checks are turned off in App Config (or no OpenAI key is configured). Review the invoice manually.
check.failed: The check could not run. Review the invoice manually or re-run it.
check.failedWithError: The check could not run: {error} Review the invoice manually or re-run it.
check.allMatch: Everything on the invoice matches this request.

locked.none: No distributions are locked to this request.

actions.blockedStale: Some locked tips changed since submission — reject so the store can re-request the corrected amount.
actions.blockedInactive: The store's payout account is not active, so a transfer can't be sent yet.
actions.hint: Approving starts the Viva bank transfer immediately and notifies the store.

reviewDialog.rejectDescription: {store}'s tips are released so it can submit a corrected invoice. Your note is sent to the store.
reviewDialog.approveDescription: This starts a bank transfer of {amount} to {store}'s linked account. It cannot be recalled once sent.
reviewDialog.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. The invoice amount before VAT is €120.00 but the payout is €124.00.
reviewDialog.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
